function stamp17(ctx,key,x,y,w,h,rot=0,opacity=1,flip=false){

 if(!Number.isFinite(x+y+w+h))return false;

// Restores the exact Surf-Transparent DS crest animation from V35.12 (not the line replacement of V35.16).
function surf17(ctx,fx,t,a,now,scale){
 const [ax,ay]=fx.from,[bx,by]=fx.to,dx=bx-ax,flip=dx<0;

 // The water grows from the attacker's location and continues through to the target.
 for(let i=11;i>=0;i--){
  const q=ease17(clamp17((t-i*.045)/.75));if(q<.015)continue;

 if(t>.65)stamp17(ctx,'pulse1',bx,by+2,56+(t-.65)*75,32+(t-.65)*32,0,a*.68,flip);

function bubble17(ctx,fx,t,a,now){

function waterfall17(ctx,fx,t,a,now,scale){

const prev3517=window.PokemonTorreV360Paint;
window.PokemonTorreV360Paint=function(ctx,fx,now,e){

 if(!im17.complete||!im17.naturalWidth)return typeof prev3517==='function'?prev3517(ctx,fx,now,e):false;

 try{
  if(fx.kind==='surf')surf17(ctx,fx,t,a,now,sc);
  else if(fx.kind==='hydropump')pump17(ctx,fx,t,a,now,sc);
  else if(fx.kind==='waterpulse')pulse17(ctx,fx,t,a,now);
  else if(fx.kind==='bubblebeam')bubble17(ctx,fx,t,a,now);
  else if(fx.kind==='waterfall')waterfall17(ctx,fx,t,a,now,sc);

};
